articles.summary: Cleburne, Texas has been a railroad hub since 1881, when the Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway first arrived. Today, The Greenbrier Companies continue that legacy while celebrating America’s 250th anniversary with commemorative boxcars created with TTX Company.
articles.title: Cleburne’s Rail Legacy: From Santa Fe Shops to America’s 250th Anniversary

articles.summary: Greenbrier’s Ultra-High-Strength Steel Gondola™ uses advanced high-strength steel to increase load capacity by up to 15% while reducing railcar weight. The redesigned gondola improves durability and efficiency for moving dense commodities such as aggregates, metals and industrial materials. The next-generation design helps railroads and shippers move more product with fewer railcars.
articles.title: Ultra-High-Strength Steel Gondola™ Increases Capacity and Durability

articles.summary: Greenbrier’s railcar Sale-Leaseback™ solution allows operators to free up capital without sacrificing control of their fleets. Railcars remain in service under flexible short- or long-term leases aligned with business needs. The program combines financing with maintenance, upgrades and fleet optimization to support sustained operational performance.
articles.title: Unlocking Capital While Keeping Railcars in Service
